classification.evidence: The sweep bug is not fixed: a bypass at the top of pool_sweep in runtime/shared_heap.c returns every pool to its list without sweeping, so the major heap never reclaims memory (the agent measured ~916 MB after Gc.full_major on a loop that keeps almost nothing live). Upstream's only test builds the compiler and runs testsuite/tests/basic; no test checks that memory is reclaimed, and the bootstrap fits in the worker's memory. The Oracle keeps upstream's check. The native regrade passed it too (S->N passed, test_tests_output PASSED).
